proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Lobbying Report
proposals.proponent: Boston Common Asset Management, LLC, on behalf of the Boston Common ESG Impact US Equity Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing Alphabet's lobbying policies, direct and indirect and grassroots lobbying payments, and board oversight of those payments.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Climate Lobbying Report
proposals.proponent: Zevin Asset Management, LLC, on behalf of Sisters of Saint Dominic of Grand Rapids and co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an evaluation and report on whether Alphabet's lobbying aligns with the Paris Agreement's 1.5°C goal and plans to mitigate misalignment.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Physical Risks of Climate Change
proposals.proponent: Pax World Funds, as lead filer, and The Comptroller of the State of New York, Thomas P. DiNapoli, on behalf of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a periodic assessment of resilience to physical climate risks and measures to mitigate them, including threats to headquarters and key assets.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Water Management Risks
proposals.proponent: As You Sow, on behalf of James McRitchie
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual reporting of quantitative water-related metrics by location, including data centers, and practices to reduce climate-related water risk.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Racial Equity Audit
proposals.proponent: The Nathan Cummings Foundation, as lead filer
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party independent racial equity audit analyzing Alphabet's adverse impacts on BIPOC communities, with a published report.
proposals.evidence: Our Board therefore recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Concealment Clauses
proposals.proponent: Whistle Stop Capital, on behalf of its clients
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing risks from use of concealment clauses limiting employees from discussing harassment, discrimination and unlawful acts.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Equal Shareholder Voting
proposals.proponent: The NorthStar Asset Management, Inc. Funded Pension Plan
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a recapitalization plan phasing out Class B super-voting shares so each share has one vote.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Government Takedown Requests
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a semi-annual report itemizing U.S. government requests to remove material from Alphabet platforms and the company's responses.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Human Rights Assessment of Data Center Siting
proposals.proponent: SumOfUs, on behalf of Mari Mennel-Bell, as lead filer
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing siting of Google Cloud data centers in countries of human rights concern and mitigation strategies.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Data Collection, Privacy, and Security
